The overall mix is also unusually concentrated in 99214. The records review cannot settle the question: only one 99215 was documented (C0213394, supported at high complexity), and the single note with moderate-or-higher data reviewed but no lab or test line is weak evidence of inflated documentation. A reviewer should first request charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims, especially the URI and back-pain visits, and check whether the notes are templated or cloned. If those charts support the billed level, the leaning should be revisited."}
